messages.en:
{07 16 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Ahh, yes, well,{01 00 00 0f 00} {04 00 00},
I suppose you know all{01 00 00 05 00}
about it then?
{07 0f 00}{01 00 00 05 00}And even if you didn't,{01 00 00 05 00} you
wouldn't want to spend time
around old turtle-breath.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Ahh, jah, noh,{01 00 00 0f 00} {04 00 00},
sa tead vist sellest{01 00 00 05 00}
kõike?
{07 0f 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Ja isegi kui ei teaks,{01 00 00 05 00} sa
ei tahaks aega veeta
vana kilpkonnahinguga.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Well, {01 00 00 05 00}even if you don't win,{01 00 00 0f 00}
if your bug's length sets{01 00 00 05 00}
a new record...
I'll still give you a nice
prize from my collection of
pre-used items!
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}You're just brimming with
excitement right now,
{01 00 00 05 00}aren't you, sprout?
{07 00 00}Well, take that excitement
and put it to work!

{07 15 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Remember, no bugs can be
returned after measuring!

{07 00 00}Catch a bug, and it's yours.{07 03 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}
Give ME a bug,{01 00 00 05 00}
and it's {ff 00 00 06}mine{ff 00 00 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Noh, {01 00 00 05 00}isegi kui sa ei võida,{01 00 00 0f 00}
kui su putuka pikkus seab{01 00 00 05 00}
uue rekordi...
annan sulle ikka kena
auhinna oma kasutatud
esemete kogust!
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Sa oled praegu lausa
elevusest tulvil,
{01 00 00 05 00}kas pole, võsuke?
{07 00 00}Noh, võta see elevus
ja pane tööle!

{07 15 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Pea meeles, putukaid ei
saa pärast mõõtmist tagasi!

{07 00 00}Püüa putukas ja see on
sinu.{07 03 00}{01 00 00 0f 00} Anna MULLE putukas{01 00 00 05 00}
ja see on {ff 00 00 06}minu{ff 00 00 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Hello there, sprout!{01 00 00 0f 00} Have
you caught a bug already?{02 04 00 0b 00}
I caught one!
No, not yet.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Tere, võsuke!{01 00 00 0f 00} Kas sa
oled juba putuka püüdnud?{02 04 00 0b 00}
Püüdsin ühe!
Ei, veel mitte.

messages.en:
{07 09 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}I apologize.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} That's me
getting ahead of myself
again.
{07 00 00}Anyhow, the record still
belongs to the {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}-mm
{0b 02 00}{ff 00 00 00}{04 1b 00}.
Yes, {04 10 00} sure does
know how to catch them!
{07 19 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Ah, the wonders of youth!

{07 00 00}Well, {01 00 00 05 00}let's measure that
puppy.{01 00 00 0f 00} Hand over that bug,
{04 00 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Noh, {01 00 00 05 00}mõõdame selle
kutsu ära.{01 00 00 0f 00} Anna putukas,
{04 00 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}And remember, I only take
bugs!{07 03 00}{01 00 00 0f 00} I'm the {ff 00 00 06}mayor{ff 00 00 00}, not
the recycling bin, mind you!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ja pea meeles, ma võtan
vaid putukaid!{07 03 00}{01 00 00 0f 00} Olen {ff 00 00 06}linnapea{ff 00 00 00},
mitte taaskasutuskast!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}But {01 00 00 0a 00}don't lose heart,
sprout! Just come on back
with another bug.
{07 14 00}I'll be right here,
{04 00 00}, tending to my
bug-related duties!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Aga {01 00 00 0a 00}ära kaota julgust,
võsuke! Tule lihtsalt tagasi
uue putukaga.
{07 14 00}Ma olen siinsamas,
{04 00 00}, ja täidan oma
putukakohustusi!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Remember the {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}-mm
{0b 02 00}{ff 00 00 00}{04 1b 00} you
caught earlier!
Well, that baby's old news!
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}You beat your own record!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Mäleta {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} mm
{0b 02 00}{ff 00 00 00}{04 1b 00}, mille
sa varem püüdsid!
Noh, see on vana uudis!
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Sa lõid oma enda rekordi!

by the {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}-mm
{0b 02 00}{ff 00 00 00}{04 1b 00}.

{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}it clean through!
My most heartfelt
congratulations,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 00 00}!

{07 00 00}See lööb rekordi, mille

{0b 02 00}{ff 00 00 00}{04 1b 00}.

{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}lööb selle puhtalt!
Minu kõige südamlikumad
õnnitlused,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 00 00}!
